name: Alberto Oculista
verdict: Madeira opticians retail chain (Alberto Oculista, SA); the company says it remains 100% owned by the founding Caires family. Nothing found.
note: Rating note (2026-10-03): family-owned per the CEO message on the company's own site ('A empresa continua a 100% na família que a fundou'). On the sleeve of Marítimo's 2026-27 home shirt; shirt sponsor since 2022 (JM Madeira, 3 Sep 2022). No human-rights finding found.
